intro: CAVA Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips offer a delightful sweet twist on traditional Mediterranean pita. These baked chips combine the wholesome texture of pita bread with a classic cinnamon-sugar coating, creating a dessert-like side that complements the savory flavors found throughout the [full CAVA menu](/). At 310 calories, they provide a satisfying sweet treat that pairs perfectly with CAVA bowls and pitas.
priceCalories: Priced between $3.25 and $3.70, CAVA Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips deliver 310 calories per serving. With 9g of protein, 48g of carbs, and 8g of fat, these chips offer more substance than typical desserts. The pricing reflects their premium position among [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) items, offering excellent value for a sweet accompaniment to your meal.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets these pita chips apart is the perfect balance of sweet cinnamon and sugar coating on crispy, baked pita bread. Unlike fried alternatives, these chips are baked for a lighter texture while maintaining satisfying crunch. The Mediterranean-inspired base elevates them beyond standard dessert chips, making them a unique offering you will not find at typical fast-casual restaurants.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips contains 310 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile: 9g protein, 48g carbohydrates, and 8g fat. The protein content is notably higher than most sweet snacks, thanks to the pita bread base. These chips provide energy from carbs while keeping fat content moderate, making them a more substantial option than many [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts) alternatives.
whatsInside: The ingredients are refreshingly simple: baked pita chips coated with cinnamon and sugar. The base starts with traditional pita bread, baked until crispy, then generously dusted with a sweet cinnamon-sugar blend. This straightforward ingredient list means fewer additives and preservatives compared to packaged snack alternatives, aligning with CAVA's commitment to quality ingredients throughout their [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) and sides.
tasteLike: These chips deliver a delightful crunch followed by warm cinnamon sweetness with subtle sugar notes. The pita base provides a slightly nutty, wheaty flavor that balances the sweetness perfectly. The texture is crispy yet sturdy, with enough body to hold the cinnamon-sugar coating without becoming soggy. Each bite offers the comforting taste of cinnamon toast with the satisfying crunch of a chip.
customize: While Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips come pre-seasoned, you can enhance your experience by pairing them creatively with items from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). Some customers enjoy them alongside Greek yogurt or as a sweet counterpoint to spicy bowls. You can also request them on the side of any curated bowl or pita to add a sweet finishing touch to your meal.
pairsWell: These sweet chips complement spicy dishes exceptionally well, balancing heat from harissa or hot harissa vinaigrette. They pair beautifully with [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) items featuring bold flavors like Spicy Lamb Meatball or Harissa Avocado Bowl. The cinnamon sweetness also works wonderfully as a palate cleanser between bites of savory proteins and tangy dressings, or alongside CAVA beverages for a complete meal experience.
healthyChoice: Compared to fried dessert options, these baked pita chips offer a lighter sweet treat with added protein benefits. The 9g of protein per serving surpasses most dessert items, while the baking process reduces unnecessary fats. However, with 48g of carbs and added sugar, they are best enjoyed as an occasional treat rather than a daily addition to health-focused meals from the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator).
howToOrder: Order Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips directly from the sides section when building your bowl or pita at CAVA. Simply ask for them by name or point them out on the menu board. They are available at most [CAVA Locations](/locations) and can be added to any order for $3.25-$3.70. Perfect for rounding out your meal or sharing as a sweet finish to your Mediterranean dining experience.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Pita Chips at 280 calories and $2.55-$2.95, the Cinnamon Sugar version offers a sweet alternative for just slightly more. While Harissa BBQ Pita Chips provide savory heat, these deliver comforting sweetness. The Whole Pita provides more volume at 320 calories but lacks the dessert-like appeal. For those wanting a sweet treat without ordering from desserts, these chips fill a unique niche.
whoShouldTry: These chips are perfect for anyone with a sweet tooth looking to end their CAVA meal on a dessert note without ordering a full dessert. Families will appreciate them as a kid-friendly option that offers more nutrition than candy. They are also ideal for those who enjoy balancing spicy Mediterranean flavors with something sweet, or anyone seeking a unique snack that bridges the gap between savory and sweet.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for their unique position as a sweet side option in a predominantly savory menu. At $3.25-$3.70, they offer good value for a satisfying portion that can serve as both a side and dessert replacement. The combination of quality baked pita with classic cinnamon-sugar coating creates a memorable flavor experience that enhances the overall CAVA dining experience and keeps customers coming back.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips?
faqs.a: CAVA Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips contain 310 calories per serving, with 9g of protein, 48g of carbohydrates, and 8g of fat. This makes them a moderately indulgent sweet option that provides more protein than typical dessert items.

faqs.q: How much do Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips are priced between $3.25 and $3.70 at CAVA locations, with pricing varying by region. This positions them at a premium compared to savory pita chip options but offers unique value as a dessert alternative.

faqs.q: Are CAVA Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips baked or fried?
faqs.a: CAVA Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips are baked, not fried. This baking process creates a crispy texture while keeping the fat content lower than fried alternatives, aligning with CAVA's focus on preparing food in healthier ways without sacrificing taste or texture.

faqs.q: What do Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips taste like?
faqs.a: These chips taste like cinnamon toast in chip form, with warm cinnamon sweetness balanced by the slightly nutty flavor of baked pita bread. They offer a satisfying crunch with generous cinnamon-sugar coating that provides comforting sweetness without being overwhelming or artificial tasting.

faqs.q: Can I get Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips with my CAVA bowl?
faqs.a: Yes, you can add Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips to any CAVA bowl, pita, or salad order. They are available as a side item for $3.25-$3.70 and make an excellent sweet accompaniment to savory Mediterranean dishes, especially those with spicy elements.
